hypothesis: The overlap count between consecutive 5-of-40 draws may exhibit first-order Markov dependence that improves one-step-ahead probability forecasts of the next overlap count.

definitions.M1: Prior-only empirical marginal distribution, shrinkage 200 toward M0.
definitions.M2: Prior-only P(O_t | O_(t-1)), shrinkage 200 toward M1.

target_protocol.cutoff_rule: history_cutoff is the immediately preceding draw date; no current/future draw enters marginal or transition counts.

inference.alternative: positive gain = comparator loss minus model loss > 0
